verdict.rationale: Casium's own pages state the human-review side: licensed attorneys review and sign every filing, and a team prepares petitions. The only nod to AI or automation is calling itself 'one intelligent platform'; nothing explains which drafting or review steps are automated. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of how AI is used in petition drafting and review, a breakdown of what is automated versus what attorneys check, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages

citations.quote: Licensed attorneys review and sign every filing.
a team preparing your petition in parallel
